units.source_text: 钉子一颗颗地像是插在松土里，轻易地拔了出来。

en.t: The nails came out easily, one after another, as if they had been stuck in loose earth.

units.source_text: 我用身子支撑着倾斜下来的板门，

en.t: I supported the tilting wooden door with my body,

units.source_text: 这濡湿了的朽木表面带着潮湿和微涨，触在我的脸颊上。

en.t: and the damp, rotten surface of the wood, moist and slightly swollen, pressed against my cheek.

units.source_text: 它并没有想像的那么沉重。

en.t: It was not as heavy as I had imagined.

units.source_text: 我把拆卸下来的板门根放在身旁的地面上。

en.t: I set the detached wooden door down on the ground beside me.

units.source_text: 可以窥见的金阁内部是一片漆黑。

en.t: The interior of the Golden Pavilion, as far as I could see inside, was pitch black.
